main_text.p: denotat, Author. Natus in urbe quadam Turcarum tunc temporis فاراب Farab, hodiè اطرار Otrar,dictâ. Obiit juxta AbulFedam anno H.398. juxta Epitomatorem Tafeensis, 391. juxta Allannab: 193.

p. 46.Tarafah Poeta] طرفة Tarafah, cui nomè عمرو بن العبد EbnChalec.Amrus Ebnol Abdi, ابن اخت المتلمس Motalammesi sororis filius, & unius è decantatis apud Arabes poematiis quæ Moallakat audiunt, author. anno ætatis 20. vel juxta alios 26. interfectus est.

Morakkesh ol Acbar, i.e.major Morakkesh ol Asgar, i. e.minor Poëtæ. major Amrus Ebn Saadi. Minor, qui majorem patruum habuit, Rabiah Ebn Mezh.Harmalah.Kamus.at secus alii,minori scil.nomen fuisse Amrum Ebn Harmalah,vel Rabiah Ebn Sofyan.
p.47.Motalammes] جرير بن عبد المسيح Iarir Ebn AbdilMafihi. v. explic. Proverb. Litera Motalammesi.
p.49.Abu Dhowaib Poeta] ابو ذويب خويلد [?] بن خالد الهذلي Abu Dhowaib AlKatil Chowailed Ebn Chaled Hodhailensis. Fuit & alius eodem nomine Poeta Aiyadensis, teste AlFirus.

p.51.Maimonides ] Ea quæ in Judæorum monimentis de eximio hoc doctore traduntur ut omittamus, apud Ebn Abi Osaibeah in historia medicorum, hoc nomine recensetur, الرييس ابو عمران موسى بن ميمون القرطبي اليهودي Alraiis (i.e. Princeps) Abu Amran Musa Ebn Maimun AlKortobi AlTehudi, seu Cordubensis Iudæus. page.notes: Arabic script is set small and partly faint; the Arabic words are transcribed as far as legible, and the uncertain word in the Abu Dhowaib entry is marked [?]. The Maimonides Arabic line is also doubtful in places. The Morakkesh headword line carries a bracket linking it to "Poëtæ. major"; this is kept as printed. The notes in the left margin are the entry references "p. 46.", "EbnChalec.", "Mezh.", "p.47.", "p.49.", "p.51." and are placed beside their lines. The page has no running head and no printed signature.
